objectives.en: I can give my opinion with phrases such as I believe, In my view and It seems to me.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להביע דעה בעזרת ביטויים כמו I believe, ‏In my view ו-It seems to me.

objectives.en: I can support my opinion with reasons (because, since, as) and results (so, therefore), and give examples with for example and such as.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לנמק את הדעה שלי (because, since, as), להראות תוצאה (so, therefore) ולתת דוגמאות עם for example ו-such as.

objectives.en: I can agree and disagree politely in a discussion.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להסכים ולהביע אי-הסכמה בנימוס בדיון.

warmup.en: Should students be allowed to use their phones in lessons? Answer in one sentence, then add 'because...'. Did you give an opinion, a reason, or both?
warmup.he: האם צריך לאפשר לתלמידים להשתמש בטלפון בזמן השיעור? ענו במשפט אחד באנגלית, ואז הוסיפו '...because'. נתתם דעה, נימוק, או את שניהם?

explanation.en: Look: 'In my view, public transport should be free for students, since many of them can't afford a car. For example, my cousin spends most of her pocket money on bus tickets.' A convincing opinion has three parts: the opinion itself (In my view...), a reason (since...) and an example (For example...).
explanation.he: שימו לב: 'In my view, public transport should be free for students, since many of them can't afford a car. For example, my cousin spends most of her pocket money on bus tickets.' לדעה משכנעת יש שלושה חלקים: הדעה עצמה (In my view...), נימוק (since...) ודוגמה (For example...).

rows: I think / I believe (that)... · In my opinion, ... · In my view, ... · It seems to me (that)...
It seems to me that people read less on paper these days.
I cycle to school, as the buses are always full.
The buses are always full. Therefore, many students cycle.
For example, / For instance, + sentence · such as + noun(s)
Team sports such as football and basketball teach you to cooperate.
I agree (with you). · Exactly. · I couldn't agree more.
I couldn't agree more – the library should open on Fridays.
I see your point, but... · I'm not sure I agree. · I'm not convinced (that)... · I'm afraid I disagree.
I see your point, but I'm not convinced it would work.

explanation.en: since and as can mean because: Since the library is closed, we're studying at home. (With the present perfect and a time, since means 'from then until now': I've lived here since 2020.) so joins two parts of one sentence: The buses are full, so I cycle. therefore is more formal: it usually starts a new sentence and has a comma after it: Therefore, I cycle.
explanation.he: since ו-as יכולים לבוא במשמעות because ('מכיוון ש'): ‏Since the library is closed, we're studying at home. (עם present perfect ומילת זמן, ‏since פירושו 'מאז': I've lived here since 2020.) ‏so מחבר שני חלקים באותו משפט: The buses are full, so I cycle. ‏therefore ('לכן') רשמי יותר: בדרך כלל הוא פותח משפט חדש, ואחריו פסיק: Therefore, I cycle.

explanation.en: agree is a verb: I agree, not *I am agree. For your own view, say In my opinion or In my view, not *According to me – keep according to for other people and sources (according to the article). such as goes before nouns, not a full sentence: sports such as tennis, not *such as I play tennis. Before a full sentence, use For example.
explanation.he: agree הוא פועל: אומרים I agree, ולא I am agree. כשמביעים דעה אישית אומרים In my opinion או In my view, ולא According to me – את according to שומרים לדעה של אחרים או של מקור (according to the article). אחרי such as באים שמות עצם, לא משפט שלם: sports such as tennis, ולא such as I play tennis. לפני משפט שלם משתמשים ב-For example.

explanation.en: To disagree politely in English, first show that you have listened (I see your point / That's true), then give your view with a softener (but I'm not sure... / but I'm not convinced...). 'You're wrong' or 'That's nonsense' sounds rude in most discussions, especially with people you don't know well.
explanation.he: כדי להביע אי-הסכמה בנימוס באנגלית, הראו קודם שהקשבתם (I see your point / That's true), ואז הציגו את דעתכם בצורה מרוככת (but I'm not sure... / but I'm not convinced...). משפטים כמו You're wrong או That's nonsense נשמעים גסי רוח ברוב הדיונים, במיוחד עם אנשים שאתם לא מכירים טוב.

examples.en: In my view, the city should build more bike lanes.
examples.he: לדעתי העירייה צריכה לבנות יותר שבילי אופניים.

examples.en: I believe online courses are useful, because you can study at your own pace.
examples.he: אני מאמין/ה שקורסים מקוונים מועילים, כי אפשר ללמוד בקצב שלך.

examples.en: Since the library closes at six, we can't study there in the evening.
examples.he: מכיוון שהספרייה נסגרת בשש, אנחנו לא יכולים ללמוד שם בערב.

examples.en: The canteen is expensive. Therefore, most students bring food from home.
examples.he: הקפטריה יקרה. לכן רוב התלמידים מביאים אוכל מהבית.

examples.en: Some apps, such as maps and dictionaries, are really useful.
examples.he: אפליקציות מסוימות, כמו מפות ומילונים, ממש שימושיות.

examples.en: It seems to me that people spend less time outside than before.
examples.he: נראה לי שאנשים מבלים פחות זמן בחוץ מבעבר.

examples.en: That's a good point, but I'm not sure I agree.
examples.he: זו נקודה טובה, אבל אני לא בטוח/ה שאני מסכים/ה.

vocab.def: what you think or feel about something
vocab.example: In my opinion, the film was too long.

vocab.def: a way of thinking about a situation
vocab.example: From my point of view, the plan is too expensive.

vocab.def: to think that something is true
vocab.example: I believe that everyone should learn to swim.

vocab.def: to have the same opinion as someone
vocab.example: I agree with you about the timetable.
I'm afraid I disagree with you.

vocab.def: a fact that explains why you think or do something
vocab.example: The main reason is that the buses are too slow.

vocab.def: for that reason; as a result (more formal than so)
vocab.example: The tickets sold out quickly. Therefore, we watched the match at home.

vocab.def: used before an example of what you have just said
vocab.example: Some subjects are hard. For example, I find chemistry very difficult.

vocab.def: used before examples (nouns) of the thing you have just mentioned
vocab.example: I love outdoor sports such as hiking and climbing.

vocab.def: an idea or opinion that is clever or correct
vocab.example: That's a good point – I hadn't thought of that.

vocab.def: completely sure that something is true
vocab.example: I'm not convinced that a ban would work.

vocab.def: used before you say what you really think, often something the listener may not like
vocab.example: To be honest, I don't think it's a good idea.
collocations: to be honest, I'm not sure

vocab.def: to be decided by something else
vocab.example: Whether we go or not depends on the weather.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a question can keep the word order of a statement, with no extra verb (literally 'what you think?'), so it is easy to say *What you think?. In English, questions about opinions need do: What do you think? Do you agree?
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית שאלה יכולה לשמור על סדר המילים של משפט רגיל, בלי פועל נוסף ('מה את חושבת?'), ולכן קל לומר What you think?. באנגלית שאלות על דעה צריכות do: ‏What do you think? ‏Do you agree?

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a present-tense verb has the same form for I, you and he (literally 'I think, you think, he think'), so the English -s for he, she and it is easy to forget: It seems to me..., My brother thinks..., Maya believes...
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית לפועל בהווה יש אותה צורה ל"אני", ל"אתה" ול"הוא" (אני חושב, אתה חושב, הוא חושב), ולכן קל לשכוח את ה-s באנגלית אחרי he, ‏she ו-it: ‏It seems to me..., ‏My brother thinks..., ‏Maya believes...

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew there is no th sound, so think can come out as 'sink' or 'tink', and therefore as 'zerefore'. Put the tip of your tongue between your teeth: think /θɪŋk/ (no voice), that and therefore /ð/ (with voice).
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין את הצליל th, ולכן think עלול לצאת "סינק" או "טינק", ו-therefore – "זרפור". שימו את קצה הלשון בין השיניים: think ‏/θɪŋk/ (בלי קול), ‏that ו-therefore ‏/ð/ (עם קול).

prompt.en: What is each phrase for? Sort them.
prompt.he: למה משמש כל ביטוי? מיינו אותם.

hint.en: Watch out for but: a different opinion usually comes after it. And I couldn't agree more is not negative!
hint.he: שימו לב ל-but: בדרך כלל אחריה מגיעה דעה אחרת. ו-I couldn't agree more בכלל לא שלילי!

explanation.en: Opinions: In my view, It seems to me, I strongly believe. Agreeing: I couldn't agree more (= I agree 100%), I completely agree, That's exactly what I think. Polite disagreement starts softly: I see your point, but... / I'm not sure... / I'm not convinced...
explanation.he: הבעת דעה: In my view, ‏It seems to me, ‏I strongly believe. הסכמה: I couldn't agree more (= אני מסכים/ה במאה אחוז), ‏I completely agree, ‏That's exactly what I think. אי-הסכמה מנומסת מתחילה ברכות: I see your point, but... / I'm not sure... / I'm not convinced...

prompt.en: Match the English phrases with their Hebrew meaning.
prompt.he: התאימו כל ביטוי באנגלית למשמעות שלו בעברית.

explanation.en: Notice how the two languages are built differently. Hebrew says 'in my opinion' in one word; English needs a whole phrase: In my opinion (not According to me). The Hebrew for 'I agree' has no 'am', and neither does English: agree is a verb, so I agree (not I am agree). After depend, English uses on: It depends on the price. The Hebrew word for 'therefore' has two English partners: so in the middle of a sentence, Therefore at the start of a new one.
explanation.he: שימו לב שהשפות בנויות אחרת. 'לדעתי' היא מילה אחת, ובאנגלית צריך ביטוי שלם: In my opinion (ולא According to me). ב'אני מסכים' אין 'להיות', וגם באנגלית אין: agree הוא פועל, ולכן I agree (ולא I am agree). אחרי depend באה באנגלית on: ‏It depends on the price. ול'לכן' יש שני מקבילים: so באמצע משפט, ו-Therefore בתחילת משפט חדש.

exercises.question: ___, teenagers should be allowed to vote at sixteen.
options: According to me
On my opinion
In my opinion
For my view

0.en: according to is for other people or sources (according to the news). For your own view, say In my opinion.
0.he: את according to משתמשים לדעה של אחרים או של מקור (according to the news). לדעה שלכם אומרים In my opinion.

1.en: The preposition is in: In my opinion.
1.he: מילת היחס היא in: ‏In my opinion.

3.en: The fixed phrase is In my view (or From my point of view).
3.he: הביטוי הקבוע הוא In my view (או From my point of view).

explanation.en: Fixed phrases for your own opinion: In my opinion, In my view, From my point of view.
explanation.he: ביטויים קבועים להבעת דעה אישית: In my opinion, ‏In my view, ‏From my point of view.

prompt.en: Listen to Noa's opinion about the new bus timetable and answer the question.
prompt.he: הקשיבו לדעה של נועה על לוח הזמנים החדש של האוטובוסים וענו על השאלה.

exercises.audio_text: To be honest, I'm not sure the new bus timetable is a good idea. I can see why the council wants to save money, but forty minutes is a long time to wait for a bus. Since most of us take the bus to school, a lot of students are going to be late.
exercises.question: What does Noa think?
options: The new timetable is a good way to save money, so she supports it.
Students should walk to school instead of taking the bus.
The new timetable is a bad idea, because students will wait too long and arrive late.
The council should run a bus every forty minutes.

0.en: She understands why the council wants to save money, but she doesn't support the plan: 'I'm not sure... is a good idea.'
0.he: היא מבינה למה העירייה רוצה לחסוך, אבל היא לא תומכת בתוכנית: 'I'm not sure... is a good idea.'

1.en: She doesn't mention walking at all.
1.he: היא בכלל לא מדברת על הליכה ברגל.

3.en: A bus every forty minutes is the new timetable – and she thinks that is too long to wait.
3.he: אוטובוס כל ארבעים דקות זה לוח הזמנים החדש – ולדעתה זו המתנה ארוכה מדי.

explanation.en: Noa disagrees politely: To be honest, I'm not sure... She accepts part of the other view (I can see why...) and gives her reason with since: Since most of us take the bus, a lot of students are going to be late.
explanation.he: נועה לא מסכימה, אבל בנימוס: To be honest, I'm not sure... היא מקבלת חלק מהעמדה השנייה (I can see why...) ונותנת נימוק עם since: ‏Since most of us take the bus, a lot of students are going to be late.

prompt.en: What does since mean in this sentence?
prompt.he: מה המשמעות של since במשפט הזה?

exercises.question: Since the library is closed on Saturdays, we study at home.
options: from that time until now
because
although
after

0.en: That is since with the present perfect and a time: I've lived here since 2020. Here, since + a full clause gives a reason.
0.he: זו המשמעות של since עם present perfect ומילת זמן: I've lived here since 2020. כאן since + משפט שלם נותן נימוק.

2.en: although shows a contrast. Here, the closed library is the reason we study at home.
2.he: although מבטא ניגוד. כאן הספרייה הסגורה היא הסיבה שלומדים בבית.

3.en: There is no order of events here – it's a reason.
3.he: אין כאן סדר של אירועים, אלא נימוק.

explanation.en: since + subject + verb often means because: Since the library is closed, we study at home. as works in the same way: As the library is closed, ...
explanation.he: since + נושא + פועל פירושו לעיתים קרובות because: ‏Since the library is closed, we study at home. גם as עובד באותה צורה: As the library is closed, ...

prompt.en: Complete Omer's opinion. Choose the best word or phrase for each gap.
prompt.he: השלימו את הדעה של עומר. בחרו את המילה או הביטוי המתאימים ביותר לכל רווח.

exercises.text: In my view, our school needs a proper canteen. ___ most students stay until four o'clock, they need a hot lunch. At the moment, there are only snacks ___ crisps and chocolate. ___, many students feel tired in the afternoon. Some schools already have good canteens. ___, my cousin's school in Haifa serves soup and salad every day. Hot meals are healthier than crisps, ___ a canteen would also improve students' health.
answers: Since
As
Because
such as
like
Therefore
So
As a result
Consequently
For example
For instance
so
and so

feedback.en: For example introduces an example, usually at the start of a new sentence with a comma after it. Before a short list of nouns inside a sentence, use such as. Is this part really an example?
feedback.he: For example מציג דוגמה, בדרך כלל בתחילת משפט חדש עם פסיק אחריו. לפני רשימה קצרה של שמות עצם בתוך המשפט משתמשים ב-such as. האם החלק הזה באמת דוגמה?

feedback.en: such as goes straight before example nouns (snacks such as crisps). It cannot start a sentence or come before subject + verb.
feedback.he: such as בא ישר לפני שמות עצם שהם דוגמאות (snacks such as crisps). הוא לא יכול לפתוח משפט או לבוא לפני נושא + פועל.

feedback.en: Therefore introduces a result, usually at the start of a new sentence with a comma after it. In the middle of a sentence, after a comma, use so. Is this part a result?
feedback.he: Therefore מציג תוצאה, בדרך כלל בתחילת משפט חדש עם פסיק אחריו. באמצע משפט, אחרי פסיק, משתמשים ב-so. האם החלק הזה הוא תוצאה?

feedback.en: because introduces a reason. Is this part a reason or a result?
feedback.he: because מציג סיבה. החלק הזה הוא סיבה או תוצאה?

feedback.en: so introduces a result. Is this part a result or a reason?
feedback.he: so מציג תוצאה. החלק הזה הוא תוצאה או סיבה?

feedback.en: Since introduces a reason. Is this part a reason?
feedback.he: Since מציג סיבה. האם החלק הזה הוא סיבה?

hint.en: Reason → Since / because. Result → so (same sentence) / Therefore (new sentence). A full example sentence → For example. Nouns → such as.
hint.he: סיבה ← Since / because. תוצאה ← so (באותו משפט) / Therefore (משפט חדש). משפט שלם של דוגמה ← For example. שמות עצם ← such as.

explanation.en: 1 Since (a reason) · 2 snacks such as crisps (nouns) · 3 Therefore, (a result, new sentence) · 4 For example, (an example sentence) · 5 ..., so a canteen would also improve... (a result in the same sentence).
explanation.he: 1 Since (סיבה) · 2 snacks such as crisps (שמות עצם) · 3 Therefore, (תוצאה, משפט חדש) · 4 For example, (משפט של דוגמה) · 5 ..., so a canteen would also improve... (תוצאה באותו משפט).

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I enjoy outdoor sports, such as I go hiking every weekend.
I enjoy outdoor sports. Such as hiking and climbing.
I enjoy outdoor sports, such as, hiking and climbing.
I enjoy outdoor sports such as hiking and climbing.

0.en: such as goes before nouns, not a full sentence. For a full sentence, use For example: I enjoy outdoor sports. For example, I go hiking every weekend.
0.he: אחרי such as באים שמות עצם, לא משפט שלם. למשפט שלם משתמשים ב-For example: I enjoy outdoor sports. For example, I go hiking every weekend.

1.en: 'Such as hiking and climbing.' is not a sentence – it has no subject or verb. Keep it in the same sentence as the noun it explains.
1.he: 'Such as hiking and climbing.' הוא לא משפט – אין בו נושא ופועל. השאירו אותו באותו משפט עם שם העצם שהוא מסביר.

2.en: No comma after such as: such as hiking and climbing.
2.he: אין פסיק אחרי such as: ‏such as hiking and climbing.

explanation.en: noun + such as + examples (nouns or -ing forms): outdoor sports such as hiking and climbing. A comma before such as is also fine: outdoor sports, such as hiking and climbing.
explanation.he: שם עצם + such as + דוגמאות (שמות עצם או צורות ing): ‏outdoor sports such as hiking and climbing. אפשר גם פסיק לפני such as: ‏outdoor sports, such as hiking and climbing.

prompt.en: Join the two sentences into one with since.
prompt.he: חברו את שני המשפטים למשפט אחד בעזרת since.

exercises.source: I'm a vegetarian. I never order burgers.
answers: Since I'm a vegetarian, I never order burgers.
Since I'm a vegetarian I never order burgers.
Since I'm vegetarian, I never order burgers.
Since I'm vegetarian I never order burgers.
I never order burgers, since I'm a vegetarian.
I never order burgers, since I'm vegetarian.
I never order burgers since I'm a vegetarian.
I never order burgers since I'm vegetarian.

wrong_feedback.match: Since I'm a vegetarian, so I never order burgers.

feedback.en: One connector is enough: since already shows the reason, so remove so.
feedback.he: מילת קישור אחת מספיקה: since כבר מראה את הסיבה, ולכן מוחקים את so.

wrong_feedback.match: Since I never order burgers, I'm a vegetarian.

feedback.en: Check the logic: since goes before the reason (I'm a vegetarian), not before the result.
feedback.he: בדקו את ההיגיון: since בא לפני הסיבה (I'm a vegetarian), לא לפני התוצאה.

wrong_feedback.match: I'm a vegetarian since I never order burgers.

feedback.en: Check the logic: since goes before the reason (I'm a vegetarian), not before the result.
feedback.he: בדקו את ההיגיון: since בא לפני הסיבה (I'm a vegetarian), לא לפני התוצאה.

hint.en: Which sentence is the reason? Put since before it.
hint.he: איזה משפט הוא הסיבה? שימו את since לפניו.

explanation.en: since + reason: Since I'm a vegetarian, I never order burgers. The since part can also come second: I never order burgers since I'm a vegetarian.
explanation.he: since + סיבה: Since I'm a vegetarian, I never order burgers. החלק עם since יכול לבוא גם שני: I never order burgers since I'm a vegetarian.

prompt.en: This sentence has a mistake. Write it correctly.
prompt.he: במשפט יש טעות. כתבו אותו נכון.

exercises.sentence: I am agree with Omer that the film was too long.
answers: I agree with Omer that the film was too long.
I agree with Omer the film was too long.

hint.en: agree is a verb, just like think.
hint.he: agree הוא פועל, בדיוק כמו think.

explanation.en: agree is a verb, so it does not need am: I agree, he agrees, we agree. (Compare: I think, not *I am think.)
explanation.he: agree הוא פועל, ולכן לא צריך am: ‏I agree, ‏he agrees, ‏we agree. (השוו: I think, ולא I am think.)

prompt.en: This sentence is not natural English. Rewrite it with a correct opinion phrase.
prompt.he: המשפט הזה לא טבעי באנגלית. כתבו אותו מחדש עם ביטוי דעה נכון.

exercises.sentence: According to me, social media is a waste of time.
answers: In my opinion, social media is a waste of time.
In my opinion social media is a waste of time.
In my view, social media is a waste of time.
In my view social media is a waste of time.
From my point of view, social media is a waste of time.
From my point of view social media is a waste of time.
I think social media is a waste of time.
I think that social media is a waste of time.
I believe social media is a waste of time.
I believe that social media is a waste of time.
It seems to me that social media is a waste of time.
It seems to me social media is a waste of time.
Personally, I think social media is a waste of time.
Personally, I think that social media is a waste of time.
Personally I think social media is a waste of time.
Personally I think that social media is a waste of time.

hint.en: For your own opinion, use a fixed phrase with my, or I think.

exercises.title: Blog post: Phones in lessons – ban them?
exercises.passage:
Last week our head teacher announced that phones will be banned in lessons from next term. A lot of students are angry about it, but in my view, it's the right decision.

First of all, phones are a huge distraction. Since notifications arrive all the time, it's almost impossible to focus on a maths problem for more than a few minutes. For example, in one history lesson last month, I counted eleven different phone sounds!

Secondly, it seems to me that we listen to each other less when our phones are on the desk. In group work, people often check their messages instead of sharing ideas. Therefore, I believe a ban could actually improve teamwork in class.

Of course, phones can be useful for some things, such as checking a word in an online dictionary. But teachers can lend us a tablet when we really need one.

– Lior, 16

COMMENTS

Maya: I couldn't agree more! My grades went up when I started leaving my phone in my bag.

Kenji: That's a good point about group work, but I'm not convinced that a total ban is the answer. I think it depends on the lesson. In art, for instance, we use our phones to photograph our work.

focus.en: th: that's has /ð/ (with voice), think has /θ/ (no voice) – put your tongue between your teeth for both. Stress: de-PENDS, SUB-ject.

prompt.en: Write a comment on Lior's blog post.

task.en: Write a comment (80-120 words) on Lior's blog post about banning phones in lessons. Say whether you agree or disagree – politely! Give two reasons with because, since or as, add one example with for example or such as, and use therefore or so once.
task.he: כתבו תגובה (80-120 מילים) לפוסט של ליאור על איסור טלפונים בשיעורים. כתבו אם אתם מסכימים או לא – בנימוס! תנו שני נימוקים עם because, ‏since או as, הוסיפו דוגמה אחת עם for example או such as, והשתמשו פעם אחת ב-therefore או ב-so.

exercises.model_answer: Hi Lior, I see your point about distractions, but I'm not convinced that a total ban is the right answer. In my view, students need to learn to control their phones themselves, since we will all use them at university and at work. A ban only hides the problem. Phones can also be really useful in class. For example, our English teacher asks us to record ourselves speaking, and then we listen and correct our mistakes. Therefore, teachers should decide when phones are allowed, as they know what works in each lesson. Simple rules such as 'phones face down on the desk' would solve most of the problem without a ban.
